item.title: Olive Ridley turtles’ satellite tagging reinitiated to track migration pattern
item.description: Kendrapara/Bhubaneswar: With behavioural and migration patterns of endangered Olive Ridley sea turtles still shrouded in the realm of scientific study, the state Forest department has reinitiated the satellite tagging of these iconic marine animals ahead of their mass nesting.
